_comment: What becomes of a feature, by its specify-core family: the first case whose families (all, when absent) and conditions hold. Conditions and actions name code: the geometry is computed, not data. An action is one of hole (placed in a setup and cut), by_slot (cut by its slot's, notch's or V-channel's operation), members (its member holes are planned one by one), covered (left to roughing), or skip with the rule and the reason's template.

conditions.cut_by_slot: a slot, notch or V-channel operation was planned that includes it
conditions.convex: an edge round on the outside of the part
conditions.not_upright: its faces are not all cylinders along the roughing setup's axis: a horizontal round, not a vertical corner
conditions.reachable: none of its flat faces points away from the roughing setup

then.reason: r{radius} edge round: not reached from the roughing setup with its wall at size, so it stays sharp (break it by hand)
chamfer: no operation cuts it, so the edge stays sharp (chamfer it by hand)
turned feature: make it on a lathe
{family}: no operation of its own; give the mesh to rough it
{family}: faces away from the {rough_from} setup, where roughing runs; not planned
